comments.body:
The quest it will appear if you have more than 116 levels.
Or have the proper skill levels.
But if you dont have the proper adv, trade or battle levels, you can't have it.

comments.author: xNiccix
comments.body:
You don't have to fulfill the requirements of the JOB in order to take on the quest. I managed to pull the quest even though I didn't have 32 battle and I only had a total of 108 levels. You just can't SWITCH to the new job and you will have to hold the job card in your inventory/quarters till you have enough levels.

As long as you fulfill the requirements that the QUEST requires (Livestock Trading etc.) you will be able to pull the quest. If you don't have the right ranks of the skill then use items to get +1 or +2, you'll still be able to pull the quest, although I suspect you will use more QMP's than usually and it will be a bit more difficult to pull, but I managed to do it with 7 QMP's..
